Hero.title: Innovation that transforms lives and spaces
Hero.description: CBR GROUP brings together cutting-edge medical technologies and high-potential real estate developments under a unified business vision.
Hero.intro: CBR GROUP is a U.S.-based company operating in two dynamic sectors: the commercialization of medical technology licenses and strategic real estate investment. Our mission is to enhance healthcare systems with innovative solutions while developing and managing real estate projects that create long-term value.

WhoWeAre.p: CBR GROUP was founded with the goal of connecting medical innovation with real estate excellence. We collaborate with global brands in the medical technology field to distribute state-of-the-art solutions to healthcare professionals. Simultaneously, we invest in and develop real estate assets in both emerging and established markets. Our dual approach allows us to diversify our impact and maximize opportunities for our partners and clients.
WhoWeAre.mission: To bring innovation to healthcare and value to real estate.
WhoWeAre.vision: To be a global benchmark in technological and real estate synergy.

MedTech.p: At CBR GROUP, we distribute exclusive medical technology licenses that enhance diagnostics, treatment, and hospital management. We partner with world-renowned companies to give hospitals, clinics, and health systems access to tools that raise the standard and efficiency of care.
MedTech.title: Our Licenses Include:

Licences.1: Bariatric Surgery Solutions by Carl Zeiss Meditec
Licences.1p: Advanced visualization systems and robotic assistance technology for bariatric and minimally invasive procedures. Precision, safety, and excellence — trusted by surgeons worldwide.
Licences.2: Dialysis Systems by Fresenius Medical Care
Licences.2p: Comprehensive equipment and solutions for dialysis therapy, improving quality of life for patients with kidney failure.
Licences.3: Diagnostic Imaging Equipment by Siemens Healthineers
Licences.3p: Cutting-edge MRI, CT, and ultrasound systems for faster, more accurate diagnoses.
Licences.4: Surgical Products by B. Braun Melsungen
Licences.4p: Surgical instruments and drug delivery systems that ensure safe and efficient procedures.
Licences.5: Anesthesia and Ventilation Equipment by Drägerwerk
Licences.5p: Advanced devices for anesthesia and respiratory support, essential in ICUs and surgical environments.
Licences.6: Wound Care Solutions by Paul Hartmann AG
Licences.6p: Innovative products for wound treatment and management, supporting rapid and effective recovery.
Licences.7p: High-precision plastic parts and systems used in medical and pharmaceutical devices.

RealEstate.p: At CBR GROUP, we invest in strategic real estate projects that combine sustainability, functionality, and high returns. We manage and develop assets in the U.S. and Latin America, focusing on high-growth urban areas and business hubs.
